description: Item-11 duplicate-execution vectors (SPEC §7.2 item 11, Keying and comparison). For each case, consume `first`, then `second`, under the same `id` against one replay guard, with a payload type that models only `payload.subject`, passing each document as received. `expect` is the outcome of the second.

cases.name: byte-identical resend
cases.why: SPEC §8.4: a retry is the same document re-sent; item 11 absorbs it.

cases.name: same members, different order and whitespace
cases.why: Two serializations identical under RFC 8785 canonicalization are the same document (SPEC §7.2, Keying and comparison).

cases.name: extra payload member the consumer's type does not model
cases.why: The comparison is over the whole received document, not the consumer's typed reading of it, which drops `note`.

cases.name: extra top-level member
cases.why: An unrecognised top-level member is part of the document (SPEC §7.2 preserves it).

cases.name: issuedAt spelled with fractional seconds
cases.why: The same instant written differently is a different serialization; a typed reading that normalises the timestamp cannot see it.

cases.name: modelled payload member changed
cases.why: Control case: a difference every reading sees.
